review.gallery: Six distinct Azizi Ruby project renders from the branded factsheet and JRE project gallery. The lobby matches the branded factsheet. Repeated crops and mixed-project interior scenes excluded.
review.location: Eight estimates verified against the developer factsheet. The JRE and Madena pins agree to five decimals and an alternate Augusta project point is nearby. No original regional map image was established. The interactive map uses the sourced project point.
review.floorPlans: Two complete 27 November 2024 concept floor plates with the JVC15BMRM001 drawing reference, linked to Ruby by Madena and Reelly. The second sheet prints two floor ranges. Fourteen portal image references reduce to nine distinct drawings by SHA-256. Repeated sizes are grouped as listing ranges, with no inferred exact unit match.

unavailable: An exact entrance, a verified developer regional map image and a full current unit-specific approved plan schedule were not established.
